submitted_prompt: 8-second vertical Omni Flash. Handcrafted Korean medical-history museum diorama, 1:5 matte-resin objects, walnut, brass and amber glass, blank white geometric pharmacy boxes, warm amber and cool teal light, smooth camera, never photorealistic. No human appears. A completed bubbling unlabeled amber bottle lands on a brass pedestal and the machine stops. A bottle-neck match cut returns to a modern Korean pharmacy miniature where one clearly nonhuman articulated wooden mannequin hand with exposed ball joints twists the cap once. Hiss vapor becomes a curved brass time rail joining blank silhouettes of the old apothecary and 1960s factory. Native bottle, machine, cap, hiss and room sounds only. No skin, faces, people, speech, music, text, letters, numbers, symbols, plaques, papers, gauges, signs, labels, logos, shake, morphing or chibi.
